steps.en: One SMS per unique individual owner
steps.id: Satu SMS untuk setiap pemilik individu yang unik
steps.why_en: At the first reminder stage, each notice gets its own SMS, so one owner can get several.
steps.why_id: Pada stage pertama, tiap notice dapat SMS sendiri, jadi satu pemilik bisa menerima beberapa.

steps.en: The SMS carries notice number, vehicle, amount and due date
steps.id: SMS memuat nomor notice, kendaraan, jumlah dan tanggal jatuh tempo
steps.why_en: The message wording lives in the database and is not in the code, so it cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Redaksi pesan ada di database dan tidak ada di code, jadi tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: SMS reminders are sent in batches to individual owners
steps.id: SMS pengingat dikirim bertahap ke pemilik individu
steps.why_en: The sending job and prod SMS are switched off in the repo settings.
steps.why_id: Job pengirim dan SMS di prod dimatikan di pengaturan repo.
